audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3-6 read Yone, Skill, Yone, Yone against the packet chart's Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Skill — and against the page's own whys, which call levels 4-5 'roughly even', level 6 the flip, first item a Kayle window, and late 'genuinely even'.
audit.why: The 49.58% win rate over 950 games is a genuinely even matchup, not a Yone-owned one; the existing prose already says so.
audit.corrected: Yone, Yone, Yone, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Skill — matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Yone levels 1-3, Kayle 6, Kayle first item, Yone late.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer tracked only Fate Sealed with no number, and Soul Unbound — the ability that actually decides when you may trade — appeared only as a dontsFull title with unrelated boilerplate underneath.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s and repeats a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit when it snaps back, so damage traded during E arrives twice; waiting it out is the concrete rule. Fate Sealed is 120/100/80s at 1000 range. Mortal Steel is 4s with the dash-knockup on the second stack, and Spirit Cleave is a 14s shield at 700 range.
audit.corrected: All four numbers now on the full layer in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull, dontsFull[1].d and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: No 'when not to fight' window existed.
audit.why: The Soul Unbound duration is exactly that window — his spirit damage is repeated on the snap-back, so trading into it doubles what you take.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Fate Sealed's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Q shred and W heal stabilize you, but his dash still edges the all-in — roughly even. Spirit Cleave shields him every 14s.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Yone's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Ascent goes ranged and R's invulnerability lets you kite his Q3 knockup — hold R for his commit, never to force a trade.

edits.before: Nashor's Tooth is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Fate Sealed's cooldown.
edits.after: Nashor's plus E's missing-health on-hit out-DPS him — he must walk to 700 range to land W.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Yone carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Even late: you out-scale on AoE, but Soul Unbound baits your R and Fate Sealed still finds you at 1000 range.

edits.before: - Yone Fate Sealed: matchup-defining — His all-in knockup. R-invuln it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Yone Fate Sealed: matchup-defining — 120s at rank 1, 1000 range; R through it. - Soul Unbound: 22s at rank 1, and the snap-back repeats a portion of his damage. - Spirit Cleave: a 14s shield.

edits.before: His all-in knockup. R-invuln it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 120s at rank 1 from 1000 range — R through it, do not walk into it.

edits.before: Yone wastes Fate Sealed — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Mortal Steel is 4s — the second stack is the dash knockup.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Soul Unbound repeats his damage when it snaps back — wait it out.

edits.before: Track Yone's Fate Sealed: His all-in knockup. R-invuln it. When it is down — E-poke + scale.
edits.after: Fate Sealed: 120s at rank 1, 1000 range. Soul Unbound is 22s and repeats his damage.

notes: diff is 'HARD' and diffRating 7.5/10 against a 49.58% win rate — I left both, since even-win-rate does not mean easy for a scaling champion who must survive levels 1-3, and the prose is consistent about that. report[8].t still recommends anti-heal 'early — his healing fights your pattern'; Yone's kit has no heal flag at all (only Spirit Cleave's shield), so that line is leaked boilerplate and misleads the buy order — it should read 'shield-piercing / raw AP' instead. Kayle's W self-peel is described as 'decaying move speed' in wants.you[2]; Riot's text says only 'grants Move Speed', so the decay detail is unverified and I left it alone.
